sources.title: AppsFlyer lays off 7% with IPO on the horizon
sources.description: Israeli adtech company AppsFlyer is laying off 100 employees, in a streamlining move in order to stay “flexible, innovative, and focused on long-term success."

sources.title: AppsFlyer to cut 100 staff
sources.description: The layoffs represent around 7% of its workforce, and follow on from cuts at main rival Adjust last year.

sources.title: Unicorn AppsFlyer lays off 100 employees in strategic restructuring | CTech
sources.description: CEO Oren Kaniel says company will focus on AI and scalability as part of long-term growth plans.
